sources.snippet: Unlike conventional Continued Pre-Training (CPT) models that overwrite all parameters and degrade mathematical, scientific, and coding intelligence, Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-Georgian-v3.2 keeps all 254 core Sceptic experts (#0..#253) 100 % frozen and expands each of the 40 MoE layers from 254 -> 256 experts by adding two dedicated Georgian specialist experts (#254 and #255) alongside ...
